$comment: Machine-readable form of this template's PATTERNS.md. Engines live in knowledge/ENGINES.md and are referenced by id, never duplicated here. Tone dials live in knowledge/TONE.md. Every value traces to a labelled claim; do not invent values.
confidence: n=3, one engine per source, one source 34% above the band

duration.note: Budget ESSAY time, not runtime — sponsor is excluded. See sponsor_slot.

engines.note: Adjudication and Briefing need mid-length: both must state an opposing position at full strength before answering it, which costs 20-30s.

promise_form.questions: Reversal Chain, Briefing — 'but what does that even mean?'
promise_form.topics: when the movements are naturally nouns — 'how it got so wealthy, why this is a problem, and what they'll buy next' (PolyMatter 0:23)
promise_form.numbered_candidates: Adjudication — 'Theory one... Theory two... Theory three'
promise_form.note: Pick the form from the engine. Topics are the most economical: three noun-phrases in one breath.

turns.above_max: no conclusion stands long enough to matter
turns.scaling_across_corpus: 2 turns in 64s; 3-5 at 3-6min; 4+ at 18min. Turn DENSITY falls as length rises.

digression.legal_position: after the promise, before the mechanism
digression.note: Engine-dependent allowance. Briefing tolerates it because presenter judgment is part of the product; Adjudication cannot — a candidate left hanging is a candidate the viewer stops tracking.
digression.evidence: PATTERNS.md §3 — one observation on one channel

measured.at: 4:00 — after the mechanism, before the close
2:20 — after the hook and promise land

sponsor_slot.rule: Always after a payoff, never inside an argument. Three legal positions: after the promise, after the mechanism, after the reframe.
sponsor_slot.confidence: INFERRED from 3 placements; varies by sponsor contract as much as by craft

hidden_premise.what: Name the unstated assumption under the opposing argument, then attack THAT rather than the conclusion.
hidden_premise.example: 'But implied in this argument is another. If Microsoft and Google acquire companies left and right but Apple rarely does, they must be sleeping on the job.'
hidden_premise.requires: mid-length — you must state the opposing case fully and fairly first
hidden_premise.evidence: OBSERVED · PolyMatter 5:40 — the strongest single move in the corpus

skeptical_check.what: A move against the script's own enthusiasm, with a concrete instance.
skeptical_check.example: 'never trust benchmarks' + the benchmark provider is funded by the company it benchmarks

declared_exposure.what: State the author's stake before offering judgment.
declared_exposure.example: 'which I'm stupidly paying $200 a month for right now' (0:04)

the_frame.what: Give a viewer with no position an axis to stand on, before the evidence.
the_frame.example: 'two types of people... pessimists sound smart while optimists make money'

institutions_with_dialogue.what: Give abstract actors motives and speech.
institutions_with_dialogue.example: 'Ireland rolled its eyes and shook its head'; Apple 'can wink at the IRS'
institutions_with_dialogue.belongs_to: reference world — see TONE.md; PolyMatter signature, not a universal rule

rate_as_opening_number.what: A rate is felt where a total is not.

wpm.note: 78-wpm spread on one format. The low end reflects visual density, not slower speech — resolve in the Frames step, never as a 'pace' dial.

causal_opener_pct.note: Measures argumentative density, NOT length. A low score on Adjudication is a signal the candidates are being announced rather than weighed.

currency.what: How long is this script true for?
currency.why: Tech and politics scripts are dated by construction. Fireship says the date out loud.
currency.example_of_decay: PolyMatter's 'everything is about to change' beat referenced a 2018 tax change.

ui_contract.movement_rail: 2-3 movements, each with a name, promise form and second budget
ui_contract.sponsor_slot: three legal positions, excluded from the essay word budget
ui_contract.currency_metadata: how long is this true for — findable later when facts expire
adjudication_honesty_checklist: Is the premise itself in the candidate set?
Can any candidate actually win against the author's prior?
Is the counter-evidence admitted at full strength, or pre-excluded?
